meta.promptText: Which vitamin C serum should I buy for dark spots and dull skin in India?

response.text:
For dark spots, uneven skin tone, and dull skin, I’d choose a vitamin C serum that combines **effective brightening with a formula your skin can tolerate**\. In India, you have good options across budget ranges, but you don't necessarily need the strongest concentration to get results.

Vitamin C can help brighten dull skin, reduce the appearance of post-acne marks, and improve uneven pigmentation over time. For stubborn dark spots, daily sunscreen is just as important as the serum.

## My top 3 vitamin C serums to buy in India

![Top 10 Vitamin C Serums In India - HealU](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/orMkla8o-ECPddeQqVhGXxs98b1Yep_mMLWxg0kcKp10TOxNGOQnaWJ4j568ImTyUG6NcgpPwoSeEffNNTFQKXK2Zituy10uDK4T1Zb0c5pfzZTdd3jFL9ySw4XZ-DDm9tI7EJXmE1SX1APWWY_RQIwzJrZheGqFoIHPEgi54kp83A2VJpy8HqqeV0xkgpZo?purpose=fullsize)

(My first choice)

**1\. Minimalist 10% Vitamin C Serum**

Budget-friendly · Best for beginners

A sensible starting point for dullness, uneven skin tone and post-acne marks. Its 10% ethyl ascorbic acid formula is a good option if you want daily brightening without jumping straight to a high-strength serum.

**Approx. budget\:** ₹350–₹700

Explore: [Minimalist official website](https://beminimalist.co/)

---

![Buy Plum Mandarin and 15% Vitamin C Glow Boost Face Serum 30 ml Online at Best Prices in India - JioMart.](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/DtrzhbFeZoJNEvwp4ks3dahLUvcbHdO7sCvoVcdZJmnerxeHASx7g4QTCtE9-y4P8tS-exEbL7ZPowFvTXpNM3p6z83SRbwzAZOn8tcO-q6eZzudNC55gS8bOY-YN_QiltUOimMhsT_n1vx3gUhxvtlWAP8pRqSVSaIKjs34V5Hpiwj3uNVqPD4HO590OD3t?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum**

For dullness and more noticeable brightening

Worth considering if your skin already tolerates vitamin C and you want a stronger formula. Start slowly rather than assuming a higher percentage will automatically produce better results.

**Approx. budget\:** ₹600–₹900

Explore: [Plum official website](https://plumgoodness.com/)

---

![Buy Cetaphil Bright Healthy Radiance Perfecting Serum (30ml) Online at Best Price in India on Tira Website & App](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gNCEgK5w2co5bSy8886LDdj73X6m-mDmT058NwlpRLtUrC_J-5qsGj2317chyTwCQIj95Lpqcjq1eRjfjhkb1M3AsQao6iepLIlv15-z50OiSydkHJ7txKnkuA8yHo2Ddk6bliZ17hVQKmRr2I7gcIuW0SnIzXJsoaxDNb-TiUbnpzqkbEcpDlJ3keveO1HM?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Cetaphil Bright Healthy Radiance Brightening Serum**

For sensitive or easily irritated skin

An alternative if strong vitamin C products tend to sting or leave your skin irritated. Its brightening approach uses ingredients other than relying on a high concentration of pure vitamin C.

## How to use it for dark spots

![Native Gentle Face Wash for Sensitive Skin, Fragrance Free, Sulfate Free, with Vitamin B3 and Aloe, Dermatologist Tested, 12.5fl oz - Walmart.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WkC1VAknnxL5ynBLmNnOAU4O93ACxRJAPAHBkzgME1n0wGKDgxwdzLUstpR8baUr9kkFfj9-eyL3t7OT0m7wNWNgcqmBP6UAt8dennOTNfp3q-R4sCqFUVjvnV_-3XUuHf9hSjbyppXptkPxMqFx_kRw3gauxBL15mMTKcrehYRgKhrWmJnF1pOKDH2IMpfk?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Cleanse**

Wash with a gentle cleanser and pat your face dry.

![Vitamin C Face Serum – Brightening & Anti-Aging Serum | Elder-Mart](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6BGX12agmsbMrrub7F6Nm-yFDY74jlMdgM5sU6G251MTts8GRkMsKnzJyVTEfvfHefsJCRaM-q5ybalifR6y3rOOfyJWZ_RE-8w8CtzoZ20HS7deb1Lo0MDjWNepf3UriNsClaQB2NCZ-n6PP03ints6Y9eoUDkhpx3fA8lYPEC8XDUg6marsAPKLmOSMvki?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Apply vitamin C**

Start with 2–3 drops, 2–3 mornings a week. Increase gradually if your skin tolerates it.

![Buy Real Purity's Light Moisture Daily Use Facial Cream Online | Real Purity](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MmzMttDyRJqA3juXcu_70rsQs2ecUZlA8ECS7OPc_m47Ld3VO0caoXzdig1aPT0q0B-nejyCBps4Qdbv243YmYczWZ4nMBXeCFMfYAOIrctcP0YUsbxDrWfDmOQpt4bnTeMSzewJhpY2ItPPXeU1vqA5MFexliEFleucqqmxHFmBLzIBc8Wz2ZfReJYWcnVr?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Moisturize**

Use a moisturizer suited to your skin type.

![Minimalist Sunscreen - SPF 50 PA++++ Lightweight Niacinamide Broad Spectrum SunCream |No White Cast |Men&Women - Price in India, Buy Minimalist Sunscreen - SPF 50 PA++++ Lightweight Niacinamide Broad Spectrum SunCream |No White Cast |Men&Women Online In India, Reviews, Ratings & Features | Flipkart.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4eZ8AZnBWoTwWGXmJMUlMIIoGvQ9L_lmFSHIxZ6zyQx2hQXvCzJ_1oR2wBEZmbU86BUOZn5PmYnJEkBHlnIczL0KWwSjWjcwM9DChu7VUHh-KRHNGmag9Rt22X8rCMqCldArWxnAi5MZ24o_bSGOVJRjGFapk_e5o5haj1oNg5hSdmeAljEVge41zNnou272?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Apply sunscreen**

Finish with broad-spectrum SPF 50 sunscreen every morning. Reapply outdoors, especially with prolonged sun exposure.

Give the routine around **8–12 weeks** to assess improvement. Dark spots may take longer, and persistent or worsening pigmentation may need a dermatologist's assessment.

For skincare, her suggestions included Salt & Stone's luxurious body wash, EltaMD's UV Daily Face Sunscreen (both tinted and green versions), a gentle vitamin C serum, a targeted Korean retinol serum, and Anua's Azelaic Acid serum for redness and hyperpigmentation. For makeup, she vouched for Wonderskin’s long-lasting peel-off lip stain and Maybelline’s Lash Sensational Sky Tubes Mascara. To combat seasonal fatigue and dryness, she highlighted Abib’s retinal-infused eye patches, Laneige’s Lip Sleeping Mask, and a Nespresso machine. Lastly, she recommended Lumineux’s peroxide-free teeth-whitening pen and a customizable water flosser for oral care. Each item was selected for its effectiveness, ease of use, and seasonal relevance.

search_results.title: 'Amazing': Beauty Expert Reveals Best Vitamin C Serums in 2026
search_results.description: Vitamin C serums are celebrated for their ability to brighten skin, reduce signs of aging, and even out skin tone. Renowned skincare experts like Ole Henriksen and Dr. Ginni Mansberg support its use, citing clinical benefits and research backing. When selecting a vitamin C serum, it's essential to match formulations to skin type—sensitive skin may require gentler products, while oilier skin benefits from lightweight and salicylic acid-enhanced formulas. Top recommended products include Medik8 C-Tetra Advanced, known for its gentle yet effective brightening effects; Neutrogena Collagen Bank 15% Vitamin C Serum for an affordable, hydrating boost; and Alpha-H Liquid Gold + Vitamin C for overnight radiance. Other notable mentions include SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic and Silymarin CF, praised for their potent antioxidant blends. Affordable and beginner-friendly options like The Ordinary's vitamin C derivative provide gentle efficacy without irritation. Consistency is key, with visible results appearing after several weeks. Vitamin C serums can be used daily, ideally in the morning under SPF. Packaging must protect from oxidation. The guide evaluates products based on skin compatibility, formula, ethics, key ingredients, and price to recommend the most efficient serums tailored to diverse needs.

search_results.title: 7 Anti-Aging Skincare Mistakes to Avoid, According to a Dermatologist-Plus What Products to Use Instead
search_results.description: Dr. Dendy Engelman, a board-certified cosmetic dermatologist with two decades of experience, shares critical anti-aging skincare advice in this article. She outlines seven common mistakes and recommends affordable, effective alternatives to enhance skin health and combat signs of aging. Key errors include using harsh scrubs, alcohol-heavy toners, relying on makeup with SPF, unsupervised steroid use, coconut oil, firming masks, and unverified night creams. Dr. Engelman advises instead to use gentle chemical exfoliants like PHA cleansers, niacinamide serum for barrier support, broad-spectrum tinted sunscreens such as EltaMD UV Clear, azelaic acid to treat pigmentation, ceramide-rich moisturizers like CeraVe, hydrating serums with hyaluronic acid from La Roche-Posay, and scientifically backed retinol creams such as RoC. She emphasizes the importance of SPF as the foundation of any anti-aging regimen and promotes a skincare approach that prioritizes hydration, barrier support, and evidence-based ingredients without causing irritation or damage. Products recommended are accessible and priced under $55 on Amazon.

search_results.title: A Facialist Told Me to Try This Brightening Vitamin C Serum - It Gave Me a Glowy Complexion in One Month
search_results.description:
The article is a personal review by a shopping writer who shares their positive experience using Ursa Major's Brighten Up Vitamin C Serum. Recommended by a facialist after a spa visit in Stowe, Vermont, the serum significantly improved the writer's skin brightness and hydration within a month, helping to reduce dryness and improve overall complexion. The serum contains key ingredients like edelweiss, rose hip, and aspen bark, providing anti-aging benefits, minimizing dark spots, exfoliation, and soothing effects. It absorbs quickly, doesn’t leave a sticky residue, and has a pleasant scent.

In addition to the serum, the writer also highlights other favorite skincare products from Ursa Major, such as the Essential Face Wipes for post-workout or travel refreshment, and the Hoppin’ Fresh Body Wash, praised for its energizing mint scent. Further featured products include a bar soap, face tonic, gel moisturizer, and recovery cream, all contributing to a comprehensive clean skincare regimen. Although some items are deemed pricey, the writer considers them worthwhile due to their performance and refreshing qualities. The products are all available for purchase on Amazon, and the piece contains affiliate links.
